sp500.channel_line: Retirement funds use broad stock indexes to track large U.S. companies, so the move can affect account balances.
sp500.signal_line: Investors watch it as a broad gauge of large U.S. stocks.

nasdaq.channel_line: Investors use the Nasdaq to track many technology companies, so the move can affect growth-heavy portfolios.
nasdaq.signal_line: Investors watch it for changes in technology and growth shares.

dow.channel_line: Investors use the Dow to track 30 large U.S. companies, so the move can show how established firms are trading.
dow.signal_line: Investors watch it as a compact gauge of large established companies.

russell2000.channel_line: Investors use the Russell 2000 to track smaller U.S. companies, so it can reflect domestic credit and demand conditions.
russell2000.signal_line: Investors watch it for the performance of smaller U.S. companies.

yield10.channel_line: Lenders use the 10-year yield as a reference for mortgages and business loans, so it can influence borrowing costs.
yield10.signal_line: Investors watch it as one gauge of long-term growth and inflation expectations.

yield2.channel_line: Markets use the 2-year yield to gauge near-term Fed policy, so it can influence short-term financing costs.
yield2.signal_line: Investors watch it for shifts in near-term interest-rate expectations.

yieldspread.channel_line: Banks compare long and short rates when pricing credit, so the yield spread can affect lending incentives.
yieldspread.signal_line: Investors watch the curve as one gauge of growth expectations.

mortgage30.channel_line: Home buyers use mortgage rates to estimate monthly payments, so changes can affect housing affordability.
mortgage30.signal_line: Housing analysts watch it for changes in financing demand.

brent.channel_line: Oil costs feed into gasoline, shipping, and airfares, so changes can reach household budgets.
brent.signal_line: Businesses watch Brent as a global reference for energy costs.

wti.channel_line: U.S. fuel markets use WTI as a crude benchmark, so changes can reach gasoline and freight costs.
wti.signal_line: Businesses watch WTI for changes in U.S. energy costs.

naturalgas.channel_line: Utilities and factories buy natural gas for heat and power, so price changes can reach energy bills and production costs.
naturalgas.signal_line: Energy users watch Henry Hub as the main U.S. wholesale benchmark.

copper.channel_line: Builders and manufacturers use copper in grids, vehicles, and electronics, so its price can affect project costs.
copper.signal_line: Analysts watch copper as one gauge of industrial demand.

dollarindex.channel_line: Businesses use the dollar to settle global trade, so its value can affect import costs and overseas earnings.
dollarindex.signal_line: Investors watch it for broad changes in the dollar against major currencies.

eurusd.channel_line: Travelers and companies convert euros and dollars, so the rate can affect trips, imports, and translated earnings.
eurusd.signal_line: Investors watch it for relative conditions in two large economies.

usdjpy.channel_line: Companies trade cars, electronics, and capital between the U.S. and Japan, so the rate can affect prices and overseas earnings.
usdjpy.signal_line: Investors watch it for differences between U.S. and Japanese interest rates.

gold.channel_line: Investors use gold as a store of value, so its price can affect commodity holdings and jewelry costs.
gold.signal_line: Investors watch it alongside currencies, inflation, and market uncertainty.

vix.channel_line: Options markets use the VIX to summarize expected stock swings, so it can affect hedging costs.
vix.signal_line: Investors watch it as one gauge of expected market volatility.

dax.channel_line: Investors use the DAX to track major German companies, so it can reflect European manufacturing and export demand.
dax.signal_line: Investors watch it as a gauge of large German companies.

nikkei.channel_line: Investors use the Nikkei to track major Japanese companies, so it can reflect Asian technology and export demand.
nikkei.signal_line: Investors watch it as a gauge of large Japanese companies.

kospi.channel_line: Investors use the KOSPI to track South Korean companies, so it can reflect chip demand and global manufacturing.
kospi.signal_line: Investors watch it as a gauge of South Korean shares.

gbpusd.channel_line: Travelers and companies convert pounds and dollars, so the rate can affect trips, imports, and translated earnings.
gbpusd.signal_line: Investors watch it for relative conditions in the U.K. and U.S.
